description: Two witnesses; different positions on different bills; a named legislator and a later introduction.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: I'm Sam Rivera with Example Housing Alliance.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: I support H.1001 and oppose S.2002.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: H.1001 would make application notices easier to understand.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: S.2002 would add reporting work for small organizations.

segments.speaker: Speaker 1
segments.text: What would H.1001 change for applicants?

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: Applicants would receive one plain-language notice.

segments.speaker: Speaker 4
segments.text: I oppose H.1001 because it leaves the appeal process unchanged.

segments.speaker: Speaker 4
segments.text: My name is Taylor Park from Example Tenant Forum.
